texts.en:
One of our £science_ship£ Science Ships has just surveyed a world that would make an excellent candidate for our first £colony£ Colony. It is of the same planet class as our homeworld, so our colonists should be quite comfortable there.

Before colonizing this world, we must extend our borders.

With the £construction_ship£ Construction Ship selected;

£dot_green£ Right-click a surveyed £system£ System containing a potential colony
£dot_green£ Select [GetBuildGrowCap] Starbase

                            £colonizable£

Once the System is claimed, we can begin the colonization process.
